naam: Bil om de beurt optillen – zittend
pose_en: He sits upright on a chair, seen from the front. Both buttocks rest evenly on the seat, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, hands resting on his thighs, shoulders level. Exactly one black arrow: it starts next to his right hip (viewer's left) and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right hip and right buttock are clearly lifted off the seat, so the pelvis is tilted with the right side higher; his right waist is shortened. His shoulders stay level and his head stays upright, both feet remain on the floor.

naam: Arm zijwaarts langzaam laten zakken – staand (excentrisch)
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart. His right arm (viewer's left) is stretched straight out to the side at shoulder height, elbow straight, thumb pointing forward; his left arm hangs relaxed by his side. Exactly one black arrow: it starts just below his right hand and curves downward toward his right thigh.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right arm now hangs straight down beside his right thigh, shoulders level and relaxed, left arm unchanged by his side.

pose_en: He stands in a staggered stance, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His left foot is one step in front, both knees slightly bent, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees with a straight back. His left hand rests on his left thigh just above the knee. His right arm hangs straight down and slightly forward toward the floor, hand in a loose fist. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his right hand and points up and backward toward his right hip.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right elbow is pulled back and up past his ribs, bent about 90 degrees, right fist next to his waist; his chest is rotated slightly open toward the viewer. Left hand still on the left thigh, legs unchanged.

naam: Hamstring aanspannen tegen je andere been – zittend (zonder bewegen)
pose_en: He sits upright on a chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Both knees are bent about 90 degrees and his ankles are crossed: the right lower leg is in front, the left foot is hooked behind the right ankle and blocks it. His hands hold the sides of the seat. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at the back of his right heel and points backward toward the chair legs.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Identical posture, nothing moves: the right heel presses backward against the left shin, the muscles at the back of the right thigh are visibly tensed.

naam: Lopen en een bal om je middel doorgeven
pose_en: He is walking, seen from the front, coming toward the viewer with his left foot one step ahead. He holds a small ball with both hands in front of his belly, looking straight ahead. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at the ball and curves horizontally around his right side (viewer's left) toward his back.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He has taken the next step, right foot now ahead. The ball is no longer in front: his right hand holds it behind his lower back, partly visible at his right side, and his left hand reaches behind his back to take it over. He still looks straight ahead.

pose_en: He kneels tall on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His knees are on the mat, lower legs flat on the floor behind him with the ankles held down under a low padded bar. Thighs and torso are vertical, forming one straight line from knees to head; hands are held in front of his chest with palms facing forward. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his chest and curves forward and down toward the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His whole body from knees to head has leaned forward as one straight plank to about 45 degrees from the floor, hips still fully straight (no bend at the waist). His hands are in front of his chest, ready to catch him. Ankles remain held under the bar.

naam: Schouder rekken – arm achter de rug langs trekken
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from behind (we see his back). His right arm is brought behind his lower back with the elbow slightly bent; his left hand reaches behind his back and grips the right wrist at the middle of his lower back. Shoulders level. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his right wrist and points horizontally toward his left side.
eind_en: END position: same back view. His left hand has pulled the right wrist across behind his back until the right hand is beyond his left hip; the right arm lies diagonally across the lower back and the right shoulder is drawn slightly down. He stays upright with level shoulders.

pose_en: He stands with both feet on the middle of a resistance band, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Knees slightly bent, hips pushed back, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees with a straight back. Both arms hang straight down, each hand holding one end of the taut band. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his right elbow and points straight up toward the ceiling.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Both elbows are pulled up and back past his ribs, bent about 90 degrees, hands next to his lower ribs, the band clearly stretched; shoulder blades squeezed together. Torso angle and legs unchanged.

pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front. Both arms are straight and held about 20 degrees away from his sides, fully rotated inward: the backs of his hands face the viewer, thumbs point toward his thighs, shoulders slightly rounded forward. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his right thumb (viewer's left) and curves outward around the hand toward the back.
eind_en: END position: same front view. Both arms are fully rotated outward: open palms face the viewer, thumbs point out and backward, the chest is open and the shoulder blades are drawn back. Arms still straight and slightly away from the body.

naam: Squat – met elastiek om de knieën
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart, toes slightly turned out. A short resistance loop band is around both thighs just above the knees, pulled taut. His hands are clasped in front of his chest. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his hips and points straight down.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He is in a squat with thighs almost horizontal, knees pushed outward directly above his feet so the loop band is clearly stretched, heels on the floor, chest up, hands still in front of his chest.

naam: Bal rond je standbeen rollen – staand
pose_en: He stands on his left leg, seen from the front, left knee slightly bent. The sole of his right foot (viewer's left) rests lightly on a small ball on the floor, diagonally in front of him to his right. Arms slightly out to the sides for balance. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at the ball and curves on the floor around behind his standing left foot.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The ball is now behind his left heel: his right leg reaches back and crosses behind the standing leg, the right foot still on top of the ball. The standing knee is bent a little more, pelvis level, arms out for balance.

naam: Bal tegen de muur schoppen – staand
pose_en: He stands upright facing a wall that is about two metres in front of him, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right); the wall is at the right edge of the image. A ball lies on the floor just in front of his right foot. His weight is on his left leg, the right foot is drawn slightly back with the heel lifted, ready to kick. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at the ball and points horizontally toward the wall.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right leg has swung forward with the foot just off the floor in front of him; the ball is rolling halfway between him and the wall. He balances on his slightly bent left leg, arms a little out to the sides.

naam: Eenbeenstand – bal tegen de muur gooien
pose_en: He stands on his left leg facing a wall about one and a half metres in front of him, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right); the wall is at the right edge of the image. His right knee is lifted so the right foot is off the floor and not touching the standing leg. He holds a medium-sized ball with both hands in front of his chest, elbows bent. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at the ball and points horizontally toward the wall.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Both arms are stretched forward at chest height with open hands; the ball is in the air between his hands and the wall. He still balances on his left leg only, right foot off the floor, body upright.

naam: Staan op een balansmat – met steun dichtbij
pose_en: He stands upright with both feet hip-width apart on a thick soft foam balance pad on the floor, seen from the front. A sturdy chair stands beside him at his right side (viewer's left) with its backrest toward him; his right hand hovers a few centimetres above the backrest without touching it, his left arm is slightly out to the side. Knees soft, eyes forward. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at the balance pad under his feet and points straight down into the pad.
eind_en: END position: same front view. Identical posture, nothing moves: he stands as still as possible on the foam pad, hand still hovering just above the chair's backrest.

pose_en: He is stepping up onto a low step platform, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His right foot is planted flat in the middle of the step with the right knee bent; his left foot is still behind the step, just leaving the floor. Body upright, arms relaxed by his sides. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his left foot and arcs up, over the step, and down to the floor on the far (right) side of the step.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His left foot is now on the floor in front of the step (on the right side of the platform), carrying his weight; his right foot is still on top of the step behind him with the heel lifting. Body upright.

naam: Step aantikken met je tenen – om en om
pose_en: He stands upright directly in front of a low step platform, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right); the step is in front of his toes. Both feet are flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms relaxed by his sides. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his right foot and curves up and forward onto the top of the step.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right knee is lifted and bent, and only the toes of his right foot lightly touch the top of the step (heel raised, no weight on it). His left standing leg is straight, body upright, left arm slightly forward as in marching.

naam: W-roeien – buiklig op een bank met halters
pose_en: He lies face down on a flat exercise bench, seen from the front at head end (his head points toward the viewer), legs straight behind him. Both arms hang straight down on either side of the bench, a small dumbbell in each hand, face looking at the floor. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his right elbow (viewer's left) and points up and outward.
eind_en: END position: same front view. Both elbows are bent about 90 degrees and lifted out to the sides up to shoulder height, the dumbbells slightly higher than and outside the elbows, so his arms and head form a clear letter W. Shoulder blades are squeezed together and down, neck long, face still toward the floor.

naam: Handen uitlopen naar plank en opdrukken
pose_en: He is bent forward from standing, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His feet are on the floor at the left of the image, hips high, knees slightly bent, and both hands are flat on the floor just in front of his toes. Exactly one black arrow: it starts at his hands and points horizontally forward along the floor (toward the viewer's right).
eind_en: END position: same side view. He has walked his hands forward into a high plank: hands under the shoulders, arms straight, body in one straight line from head to heels, toes on the floor in the same spot as before.
